content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RITES IT Professional Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through the career section of the official RITES website. Follow the steps below to submit the application form. Fill in personal, educational and experience details. Upload required documents. Pay the application fee. Submit and download the final application form.

faq.question: Q1. What is RITES IT Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: RITES IT Professional Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by RITES Limited for hiring experienced IT professionals on a regular basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RITES IT Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available for Deputy General Manager, Senior Manager and Manager posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RITES IT Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for RITES IT Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have relevant engineering or postgraduate qualifications in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or related disciplines along with required experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RITES IT Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 41 years for Deputy General Manager, 38 years for Senior Manager and 35 years for Manager posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for RITES IT Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General/OBC candidates need to pay ₹600 plus applicable taxes, while EWS/SC/ST/PwD candidates need to pay ₹300 plus applicable taxes.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for RITES IT Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the Career section of the official RITES website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RITES IT Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection includes document scrutiny, written test and interview depending on the post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary under RITES IT Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from ₹50,000–₹1,60,000 to ₹70,000–₹2,00,000 depending on the post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates check the official notification?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official notification from the RITES website.
